_comment: VECTRA v0.1 default configuration. Every threshold below is a starting value marked UNCALIBRATED: none of these numbers has been fitted to real market data. Do not treat them as established constants.

validation._comment: Quote validation gates. max_spread and the time thresholds are absolute price units / milliseconds.

behavior._comment: Observation windows are counted in events (ticks), not wall-clock time.

exhaustion._comment: UNCALIBRATED weights of the movement-exhaustion hypothesis score.

prediction._comment: UNCALIBRATED rule thresholds. Scores are not calibrated probabilities.

risk._comment: UNCALIBRATED limits. Prices are absolute price units (e.g. 0.00015 = 1.5 pips on a 4-decimal pair).

execution._comment: Simulated venue model. Probabilities are UNCALIBRATED simulator assumptions, not observed venue statistics.

telemetry._comment: Median/p95/p99 are only reported when at least this many samples exist.
